# role-name[¶](#role-name "Permanent link")

This rule checks role names to ensure they conform with requirements.

Role names must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters and the underscore `_` character.
Role names must also start with an alphabetic character.

For more information see the [roles directory](https://docs.ansible.com/projects/ansible/devel/dev_guide/developing_collections_structure.html#roles-directory) topic in Ansible documentation.

`role-name[path]` message tells you to avoid using paths when importing roles.
You should only rely on Ansible's ability to find the role and refer to them
using fully qualified names.

## Problematic Code[¶](#problematic-code "Permanent link")

[](#__codelineno-0-1)`---`\
[](#__codelineno-0-2)`-`` ``name``:`` ``Example playbook`\
[](#__codelineno-0-3)`  ``hosts``:`` ``localhost`\
[](#__codelineno-0-4)`  ``roles``:`\
[](#__codelineno-0-5)`    ``-`` ``1myrole`` ``# <- Does not start with an alphabetic character.`\
[](#__codelineno-0-6)`    ``-`` ``myrole2[*^`` ``# <- Contains invalid special characters.`\
[](#__codelineno-0-7)`    ``-`` ``myRole_3`` ``# <- Contains uppercase alphabetic characters.`\

## Correct Code[¶](#correct-code "Permanent link")

[](#__codelineno-1-1)`---`\
[](#__codelineno-1-2)`-`` ``name``:`` ``Example playbook`\
[](#__codelineno-1-3)`  ``hosts``:`` ``localhost`\
[](#__codelineno-1-4)`  ``roles``:`\
[](#__codelineno-1-5)`    ``-`` ``myrole1`` ``# <- Starts with an alphabetic character.`\
[](#__codelineno-1-6)`    ``-`` ``myrole2`` ``# <- Contains only alphanumeric characters.`\
[](#__codelineno-1-7)`    ``-`` ``myrole_3`` ``# <- Contains only lowercase alphabetic characters.`\
